title: Cervical Screening Test (HPV)
sourceName: Australian Government Department of Health and Aged Care — National Cervical Screening Program
eligibilitySummary: Aged 25 to 74 with a cervix, recommended every 5 years.
todo: Clinical review needed for individual risk modifiers, HPV history, and immune status.

title: Breast Screening (Mammography)
eligibilitySummary: Free mammogram every 2 years for women aged 50–74. Women aged 40–49 can also access free screening.
todo: Clinical review needed for personal or family history of breast conditions.

title: National Bowel Cancer Screening Program
sourceName: Australian Government Department of Health — National Bowel Cancer Screening Program
eligibilitySummary: Aged 45 to 74, free home test kit every 2 years.
todo: Clinical review needed for family history or pre-existing bowel conditions.

title: Heart Health Check (CVD Assessment)
sourceName: Heart Foundation Australia & Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (RACGP)
guidanceVersion: 2023 Australian Guideline for assessing and managing cardiovascular disease risk
eligibilitySummary: Recommended annually for people aged 45 and over.
todo: Clinical review needed for diabetes, blood pressure history, or smoking status.
